passages.text: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel, he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses spoke to all the people of Israel.
Moses said, “I am one hundred and twenty years old today.
I cannot go out and come in anymore.
The LORD has said to me, ‘You will not cross this Jordan River.’”
passages.original: וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם בֶּן־ מֵאָה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל ע֖וֹד לָצֵ֣את וְלָב֑וֹא וַֽיהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will go ahead of you.
The LORD will destroy these nations before you.
You will take their land.
Joshua will go ahead of you.
The LORD has said this.
passages.original: יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ ה֣וּא׀ עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֗יךָ הֽוּא־ יַשְׁמִ֞יד אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛לֶּה מִלְּפָנֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ ה֚וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act against these nations.
The LORD will treat them as He treated Sihon and Og.
Sihon and Og were kings of the Amorites.
The LORD destroyed Sihon and Og.
The LORD destroyed their land.
The LORD will do the same to these nations.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לְסִיח֥וֹן וּלְע֛וֹג מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וּלְאַרְצָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁמִ֖יד אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will give these nations into your hands.
You will have power over them.
You must do to them everything I have commanded you.
You must obey all my instructions.
passages.original: וּנְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is your God.
God goes with you.
God will never leave you.
God will never forsake you.
Be strong.
Be courageous.
Do not be afraid of them.
Do not be terrified of them.
passages.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֥וּ וְאַל־ תַּעַרְצ֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יַעַזְבֶֽךָּ׃פ

passages.text: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall give it to them as an inheritance.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Joshua was his chosen successor.
Moses called for Joshua.
All Israel was present.
Moses spoke to Joshua.
Moses said, “Be strong.
Be courageous.
You will go with this people.
You will enter the land with them.
The LORD promised this land to their fathers.
The LORD swore to give it to them.
You will give this land to the people.
You will give it to them as their inheritance.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לְעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥נָּה אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD goes ahead of you.
The LORD stays with you.
The LORD will not leave you.
The LORD will not abandon you.
Do not be afraid.
Do not be discouraged.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֞ה ה֣וּא׀ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑ךָּ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א וְלֹ֥א תֵחָֽת׃

passages.text: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses wrote down this law.
The law was God's instruction for Israel.
Moses gave the law to the priests.
The priests were the sons of Levi.
The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
Moses also gave the law to all the elders of Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֗הּ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הַנֹּ֣שְׂאִ֔ים אֶת־ אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then Moses commanded them, “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt, during the Feast of Tabernacles, when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses gave a command to the priests and elders.
He told them what to do every seven years.
At the end of every seven years, there is a special time.
This time is called the year of remission of debt.
During this year, the Feast of Tabernacles takes place.
All the people of Israel must come together at this time.
They must gather before the LORD their God.
They must come to the place that God will choose.
At that place, they must read this law.
They must read it so that all Israel can hear it.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֥ו מֹשֶׁ֖ה אוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים בְּמֹעֵ֛ד שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁמִטָּ֖ה בְּחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃ בְּב֣וֹא כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֑ר תִּקְרָ֞א אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את נֶ֥גֶד כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Assemble the people—men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates—so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Israel.
He gave them a command from God.
He told them to gather all the people together.
Gather the men.
Gather the women.
Gather the children.
Gather the foreigners who live in your towns.
Bring everyone together.
Do this so they will listen.
Do this so they will learn.
They must learn to fear the LORD your God.
They must keep all the words of this law.
They must do everything God commands.
passages.original: הַקְהֵ֣ל אֶת־ הָעָ֗ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְהַנָּשִׁים֙ וְהַטַּ֔ף וְגֵרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֨עַן יִשְׁמְע֜וּ וּלְמַ֣עַן יִלְמְד֗וּ וְיָֽרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָֽׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
passages.sermon:
The children of Israel do not know the law.
These children will listen.
These children will learn.
They will learn to fear the LORD your God.
They will do this as long as you live on the land.
You are crossing the Jordan River to possess this land.
passages.original: וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יָדְע֗וּ יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ וְלָ֣מְד֔וּ לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said that Moses would soon die.
The LORD told Moses to call Joshua.
The LORD told Moses and Joshua to stand at the Tent of Meeting.
The LORD said He would give Joshua a command there.
Moses and Joshua went to the Tent of Meeting.
Moses and Joshua stood at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן קָרְב֣וּ יָמֶיךָ֮ לָמוּת֒ קְרָ֣א אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וַאֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ מֹשֶׁה֙ וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
passages.sermon: The LORD appeared at the tent.\r\nHe appeared in a pillar of cloud.\r\nThe pillar of cloud stood at the entrance to the tent.
passages.original: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה בָּאֹ֖הֶל בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֑ן וַיַּעֲמֹ֛ד עַמּ֥וּד הֶעָנָ֖ן עַל־ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃ס

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “You will soon die and join your ancestors.”
The people of Israel will rise up after you die.
They will worship foreign gods in the land they are entering.
They will turn away from Me.
They will break the covenant I made with them.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲזָבַ֕נִי וְהֵפֵר֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks to Moses.
The LORD says He will become angry with the people of Israel on a certain day.
The LORD will abandon the people on that day.
The LORD will hide His face from them.
The people will be left without God's protection.
Many troubles will come upon them.
They will suffer many afflictions.
On that day, the people will speak.
They will say, “These disasters have come upon us because our God is not with us.”
passages.original: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣י ב֣וֹ בַיּוֹם־ הַ֠הוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּ֞ים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤י מֵהֶם֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לֶֽאֱכֹ֔ל וּמְצָאֻ֛הוּ רָע֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְצָר֑וֹת וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הֲלֹ֗א עַ֣ל כִּֽי־ אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהַי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י מְצָא֖וּנִי הָרָע֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God described the people of Israel.
God said He would hide His face from them on a certain day.
God would do this because the people did much evil.
The people turned to other gods.
God would hide His face because of their evil and their idolatry.
passages.original: וְאָנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עַ֥ל כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י פָנָ֔ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

passages.text: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses and the Israelites.
God commanded them to write down a song.
God told them to teach this song to the Israelites.
God said to put the song in the mouths of the Israelites.
God wanted the Israelites to recite the song.
God said this song would be a witness for Him against the Israelites.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְלַמְּדָ֥הּ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣הּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּהְיֶה־ לִּ֜י הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לְעֵ֖ד בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God promised to give their fathers a land.
This land flows with milk and honey.
God will bring the Israelites into this land.
The Israelites will eat in this land.
They will have enough food.
They will become prosperous.
Then the Israelites will turn to other gods.
They will worship these other gods.
They will reject God.
They will break God’s covenant.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אֲבִיאֶ֜נּוּ אֶֽל־ הָאֲדָמָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֗יו זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְאָכַ֥ל וְשָׂבַ֖ע וְדָשֵׁ֑ן וּפָנָ֞ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַעֲבָד֔וּם וְנִ֣אֲצ֔וּנִי וְהֵפֵ֖ר אֶת־ בְּרִיתִֽי׃

passages.text: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses about the Israelites.
God said troubles and afflictions will come upon the Israelites.
When these troubles happen, the song will speak as a witness against them.
The song will not be forgotten by their descendants.
God knows the hearts and inclinations of the Israelites.
God knows what they do even today.
God knows this before He brings them into the land He promised to give them.
passages.original: וְ֠הָיָה כִּֽי־ תִמְצֶ֨אןָ אֹת֜וֹ רָע֣וֹת רַבּוֹת֮ וְצָרוֹת֒ וְ֠עָנְתָה הַשִּׁירָ֨ה הַזֹּ֤את לְפָנָיו֙ לְעֵ֔ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ כִּ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת־ יִצְר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא עֹשֶׂה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֲבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבָּֽעְתִּי׃

passages.text: So that very day Moses wrote down this song and taught it to the Israelites.
passages.sermon: Moses was the leader of the Israelites.\r\nOn that very day, Moses wrote down this song.\r\nMoses taught the song to the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיְלַמְּדָ֖הּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun.
The LORD gave Joshua a command.
The LORD said, "Be strong."
The LORD said, "Be courageous."
You, Joshua, will lead the Israelites.
You will bring the Israelites into the land.
I, the LORD, promised this land to the Israelites.
I, the LORD, will be with you."
passages.original: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן וַיֹּאמֶר֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶֽאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבִיא֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לָהֶ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: When Moses had finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end, he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses finished writing all the words of this law in a book.
He wrote from the beginning to the end.
The Levites carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
Moses gave a command to the Levites.
He said, “Take this Book of the Law.
Place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God.
Let it remain there as a witness against you.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְתֹּ֛ב אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־ הַזֹּ֖את עַל־ סֵ֑פֶר עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃ וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹ֥שְׂאֵ֛י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ לָקֹ֗חַ אֵ֣ת סֵ֤פֶר הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וְשַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔וֹ מִצַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָֽיָה־ שָׁ֥ם בְּךָ֖ לְעֵֽד׃

passages.text: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
Moses knew the Israelites were rebellious.
Moses knew the Israelites were stubborn.
Moses said the Israelites rebelled against the LORD while he was still alive.
Moses said the Israelites would rebel even more after his death.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶֽת־ מֶרְיְךָ֔ וְאֶֽת־ עָרְפְּךָ֖ הַקָּשֶׁ֑ה הֵ֣ן בְּעוֹדֶנִּי֩ חַ֨י עִמָּכֶ֜ם הַיּ֗וֹם מַמְרִ֤ים הֱיִתֶם֙ עִם־ יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאַ֖ף כִּי־ אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹתִֽי׃

passages.text: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses spoke to the people.
Moses said, “Gather all the elders of your tribes before me.
Bring all your officers as well.
I will speak these words to them.
They will hear everything I say.
I will call heaven to be a witness against them.
I will call earth to be a witness against them.”
passages.original: הַקְהִ֧ילוּ אֵלַ֛י אֶת־ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֔ם אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Israel.
Moses was their leader and prophet.
Moses said, "I know what you will do after I die.
You will become completely corrupt.
You will leave the path I commanded you to follow.
In the future, trouble will come upon you.
This will happen because you will do evil in the LORD’s sight.
You will make the LORD angry by what you do with your own hands."
passages.original: כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אַחֲרֵ֤י מוֹתִי֙ כִּֽי־ הַשְׁחֵ֣ת תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־ הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֨את אֶתְכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעָה֙ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֔ים כִּֽי־ תַעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת־ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְהַכְעִיס֖וֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then Moses recited aloud to the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song from beginning to end:
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
He spoke to all the people of Israel.
He spoke so everyone could hear him.
He recited the words of this song.
He spoke the song from beginning to end.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּאָזְנֵי֙ כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃פ
